notes.title: Players slam New World's recent changes via Steam reviews
notes.content:
Amazon's MMO, New World, has seen its aggregate user reviews on Steam fall from "mostly positive" to "mixed" in the last 30 days.

As spotted by TheGamer, feedback seems mostly to criticise the game's "grind" and its litany of bugs and issues.

"It saddens me to have to write a negative review," wrote one player. "The game has a great foundation but is pretty much completely screwed over by bad decisions from higher-ups."

Read more

notes.title: Server mergers are "on the horizon" for Amazon's New World
notes.content:
Server merges are "on the horizon" for Amazon's MMO, New World.

In a lengthy update on the official forum, community manager Luxendra explained that while there were plans to introduce mergers, "there are a few action items that need to be addressed" before the team can be "confident that merging worlds will be a net positive experience for our players".

"We need to test our technology. We had tested world merges in Closed Beta which caused a persistence issue that has since been resolved, and we continue to test merges with our team and non-public worlds," the post explained, adding that any changes will first be tested in The Public Test Realm from tomorrow (Monday) morning.

Read more

notes.title: It looks like New World has shed around half its playerbase since launch
notes.content:
Amazon's new MMO, New World, has reportedly lost more than half its playerbase just a month after its launch on PC.

Despite hitting an impressive all-time concurrent peak of just shy of a million players on 3rd October, Forbes spotted that the numbers on SteamCharts have taken something of a dip, with its concurrent rate falling around 135,000 players every week since launch.

As of last week, the MMO sported a concurrent player count of 508,000 - roughly half of what it was at the start of the month.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon now working on New World region transfer after player backlash
notes.content:
Amazon is now working on enabling New World region transfers after a vociferous player backlash.

Earlier this month, Amazon U-turned on letting New World players transfer their characters to a server in a different region.

Following New World's explosive launch, Amazon asked players to join servers with low wait times as it worked on increasing the population caps of existing servers.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon gives New World players "The Stoic" in-game title and "Waiting" emote for free to make up for terrible launch server queues
notes.content:
Amazon is giving New World players "The Stoic" in-game title and the "Waiting" emote for free to make up for the MMO's terrible launch server queues.

When New World launched last month it exploded in popularity, becoming the fifth most-popular game on Steam of all-time by concurrent players.

But Amazon struggled to cope with the enormous launch numbers, and server queue wait times ballooned.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon now blocks New World players from creating new characters on full servers
notes.content:
Amazon is blocking New World players from creating new characters on full servers as it continues to struggle with the MMO's explosive popularity. Now, when a server is full it will be greyed out, with a note to say character creation is not possible.

Of course, if you've already created a character on a full server, you can log in (or, queue to log in, anyway) and play with them as normal.

Amazon signalled the new system last night as it launched a server status page on its website. At the time of this article's publication, many of the servers are marked as full.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon suggests new New World players join low wait time servers ahead of character transfer feature
notes.content:
Amazon has asked new New World players to join servers with low wait times as it works on increasing the population caps of existing servers.

New World had a huge launch this week, reaching a peak of 758,543 concurrent players on Steam. It's the fifth most-popular game ever on Steam, according to peak concurrents.

Amazon said over a million players entered New World on launch day - and that number has increased each day since. It said that while it expected a big launch, it was "frankly surprised" by the huge influx of players, which led to extremely long queue times.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon to offer New World players free server transfers as queue times balloon
notes.content:
Amazon will offer New World players free server transfers in the next two weeks, with lengthy queue times blighting the MMO's hugely popular launch.

New World launched yesterday and peaked at 707,230 concurrent players - the fifth-highest concurrents figure ever seen on Valve's platform. At one point it was the most popular game on Steam, ahead of Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.

But this popularity has made for extremely long queue times - for some over nine hours - that has made New World practically unplayable for many customers. In fact, most of the game's negative user reviews on Steam are complaints about these server problems.

Read more

notes.title: New World graphics card failures down to dodgy soldering, says EVGA
notes.content:
Back in July, reports began circulating that the beta of Amazon's MMO New World was bricking pricey EVGA-manufactured RTX 3090 graphics cards. A subsequent statement from Amazon insisted the beta was "safe to play", and that's now been corroborated by EVGA, after its investigation into the issue revealed hardware failures were the result of dodgy soldering.

When reports of card failures began to surface, some users speculated the problem was due to power spikes and overheating caused by uncapped framerates in the New World beta's menus. While Amazon set about capping the framerate as a precautionary measure, EVGA began replacing affected cards and investigating returns to find out exactly what was going on.

Sharing its findings with PC World, EVGA has now revealed that while it wasn't able to replicate the issue using a copy of the New World beta, under X-ray analysis the less-than-two-dozen impacted RTX 3090s it received - all originating from an early 2020 production run - displayed "poor workmanship" on the soldering around the MOSFET circuits that powered the cards.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon's New World hits 200,000 concurrent players
notes.content:
It looks like Amazon may finally have a hit on its hands - New World hit the 200,000 concurrent players mark over the weekend.

The MMO hit a peak concurrents figure of 200,856 on Steam yesterday, making it the sixth most popular game on Valve's platform, ahead of the likes of Rust, Warframe, Rainbow Six Siege and Football Manager 2021.

New World is currently in closed beta, with a release date proper set for 31st August.

Read more

notes.title: Amazon responds after reports its MMO New World is bricking pricey RTX 3090 cards
notes.content:
UPDATE 22ND JULY 2021: Amazon Games has issued a new statement on New World and recent concerns with graphics cards, announcing a patch to cap the framerate on the MMO's menu screen.

In the statement, Amazon said it had received a "few" reports of players using high-performance graphics cards experiencing hardware failure when playing New World.

"New World makes standard DirectX calls as provided by the Windows API. We have seen no indication of widespread issues with 3090s, either in the beta or during our many months of alpha testing," the statement continues.

Read more

notes.title: Feb 20 Update - The Dreaded Save Game
notes.content:
I wanted to address a complaint New Players were having with saving their game progress, which in the past was done by "Getting a room" at the Tavern or Building a Completed House and sleeping there. In either case the Save was intentional and In a large world with remote islands where construction are possible anywhere it can be easy to get stuck in a really bad situation, or perhaps by accident ruin your characters reputation and suddenly not want a save game.

But recent reviews from new players have me a bit on the fence, so for this I thought I would try a new save game approach which will move the starting point from the Docks"starting area" to Town or to any house currently under construction or built. 

Hopefully this will give newer players an easier launch getting into the wild, but also does open the risk of perhaps getting stuck in the wilds.

 So for this I say, be careful and use those save game slot :P

As always, your feedback is welcome!

notes.title: Feb 2021 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We had several patches this week, so I wanted to give a quick summary here. 

First, I have removed the speech from the npcs as my voice acting quality was very poor and it wasnt really worth slowing up the dialog system which is now very quick to skip right over those long winded storylines.

We have managed to get all the old Combat Skills into the new directional swing system while maintaining the freedom of movement on all skills with the exception of the spin attacks that still leave the player in place while attacking. We will continue testing as it has somewhat lowered the difficulty of combat slightly, but the change does seem to be much more fast placed, removing the clunky stop and go actions from the old combat system.

We have changed the vaulting and climbing skill so now it should only attempt a climb while Holding "Run" and Pressing Forward. As the run key was pulling double duty with the camera zoom, it made camera navigation difficult up close around the npcs.

We have also added a tool tip popup to many of the non tool based skills that I think alot of players might have been missing - Opening Hatches, Harvesting Plants, Disabling Traps, Reloading and Firing  Cannons. Im sure Ive missed many more, but with it in place it should be easy to add in the rest as we rediscover them.

And Finally. A Level of Detail System!  How we made it this far without one is beyond me, anyways, you should now see a more properly reduced resolution as objects move away from the player. The  reduction does appear to really give a nice boost to performance.

As always, If ya find anything wrong or any ideas on how to make things better, hit me up, I love hearing from ya all.

Hope you all enjoy the update, stay safe and good hunting!!

notes.title: Return to New World Horizon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/44abff0ff0321a049579e565bbe0a49f2c7fe8d9.png[/img]

We are proud to announce our return to active development of New World Horizon.  We recently got our team connected up remotely from home and the progress has once again resumed. Coming Back to the Emerald Peaks after so long I soon realized the complexity of the controls and knew that making things a bit easier to learn and play again would be our first priority.

Our new system replaces all the keybinds and joystick controls with a single Mouse Wheel Control to Select all tools. Players will also start with a complete set of Level 1 Tools with upgrades available from the Npc and Resources have been made to be a bit more plentiful to take some of the grind out of the game.

The Directional Key combat system has been replaced with an easy to use single Mouse Click system, while using the movement keys and jumps to fire off the various different attacks available.

Though im sure there are many game facets that I might have overlooked in getting the new stuff up and working, im happy to said I look forward again to fixing any issues you might have with this or future updates.

Stay Safe and Keep Gaming!!

notes.title: Easter Hunt Event
notes.content:
[b]Free The Easter Bunny from Rat Dungeon !!!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/e8e1f1aebd7d159982574b78c6e792da2dda6019.png[/img]

The Rules - Beneath each of the 10 dungeons is a newly added zone with a special locked door. To get a key a player must find the correct world boss that holds that key, kill it and retrieve the key to open it. Once the door has been opened, a new world boss and key will be chosen and unknown to the player, so repeat killing will yield nothing but xp. Killing the correct boss though guarantees a drop of either a rare item or the key, but you will get one. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/79e0eeb4777837dd7e3075c68a643cf0f1d28cd1.png[/img]

Beyond each door also contains a new type of chest. They are well defended by many traps and like the dungeons come in 10 levels of difficuly, but inside each chest a chance at progressively better gear. Level 1 and 2 chests will drop +2 weapons and gear. Level 3 and Up will give up to that level of gear if needed by the player, up to 4 attempts will be made to upgrade a player, if not a players are just rewarded with gold.

Regardless of the success or failure of the chests, once the key is used on the door, the quest continues. Though the last few bosses are really tough, the gear reward could be huge on this holiday event as freeing our beloved bunny and completing the quest is Choice of Level 6 Blunderbuss Pistol or a Level 1 Warship.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/b70e5006ddb1e80a855e294bb56a186c71e23e30.png[/img]

As our dungeon network has now greatly expanded we have doubled the burn time of lanterns and increased the drop of mushrooms for seeing in the dark. Also as bosses are now dropping heavy gear, we have added measure to prevent damaging them while stuck or froze, so just save your ammo.

Ok, Best of luck to you all. Good Hunting and Happy Easter!!

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/4d1086d645e5533df4115c546ea092aa2dbdfb41.png[/img]
We have been hard at it these last few months, so much so, that as usual we fail to give timely update information. But as it is the holiday season, we mark this winters update as we did with our original beta release with a great event.

The Holiday Treasure Hunt : Buried somewhere within the walls of Emerald Peaks lies a fortune! Get your pick axe and start digging. (this event is for new characters only)  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/6d4e60369ed71398fafbc07fe94bd9a67370b92f.png[/img]
And for those experienced players, we have added a new horse vendor. Players completing the Governors quest chain will gain access to a variety of new mounts for speedy travel. Your quest is not an easy one though, as it will put you at odds vs many of the lands toughest foes.

Our recent resource update added many new commodities - Stone, Brick, Vines, Rope, Herbs, Ore, Ingots, Cotton, Cloth and Mushrooms as well as the addition of a player build Forge and Dock System.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/3dbaa1379a9e9818f25b82e99dd9d8d4791fbc25.png[/img]

 Unload your Cannons and fire up the forge. Lets put all that iron to use regrading up the guns. I hope you guys have been saving it up, its about to be rare so stop selling it to the NPCs.

As your weapons improve, so decreases the chance of success, but the addition of a new Rare Red Ore will improve your chances even more,   scarce and difficult to harvest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/2ac6e77b1b7b8df6ef910a7ecea55f58c2b61982.png[/img]

With your newly upgraded arsenal, life at sea is a bit easier. Sink pirate ships and retrieve their loot, check out the new undersea life and perhaps discover other sunken ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/c1e481fc682b86172d7f999c9183bf06c4625aad.png[/img]
 Our final and probably biggest addition to this update though came from you guys...

The New Combat System - Though the old system still is in place, a new option has been added giving directional attack using a simple mouse click with different movement keys pressed.

Right Click will no longer put away weapon as it is automatic when Idle or left clicking gun away.  The current  system is not set in stone and might still need some fine tuning, but it does seam to play much smoother so I hope you enjoy it and look forward to your input on how to continue to improve it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/42fb79f3f1953dc1b0c7b7dbecb27ab3205d8107.png[/img]
 Thank you everyone for your wonderful letters and suggestions. I hope you enjoy the update!

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Fall Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34425712/5d5e9b9d1df0b3568682dcfc6952419fa012cc19.png[/img]

 The game has really exploded with the addition of new sound effects, animations, effects and improvements throughout our massive world.  New Abilities in swimming, skinning game, 2 handed melee, farming, sailing with dynamic wind, rolling and leaping attacks.

Extensive optimizations have improved us almost 30% this month and the gameplay really feels amazing now. The controls have really firmed up and with the new combat stance and library of new attacks, controls are now out of this world.

Numerous bug fixes and community suggestions (check our community hub for the daily stuff)

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34425712/e229b1b771cfb8ce953aa9238030d0f87cceb092.png[/img]We have made some serious improvements over the last month, improving the overall look of the game, expanded the tutorial, save game system, gathering, merchant ui, game controller system, pet ai and many new dungeon adventures, tricks and traps,  player suggestions and bug fixes.

But still the game difficulty is a bit much so in this update we have added some serious quality of life improvements.

First, a major change to the combat system, increasing the swing speed and increasing the strike window timing. Though still in need of further playtesting, it seems to have really smoothed out combat a bit and hopefully something I can continue to improve. Also we have increased the drop rate to lower and mid grade mobs to help newer players get started and added in mid grade weapon drops to assist in getting equipped. World boss drops now also include tools up to level 5 in grade. And finally, home construction materials have been reduced to help get players into building up there homestead.

Hope you guys are enjoying the direction of our project and look forward to any ideas for further improvements.

Be Safe and Good Hunting!

We have finished the 4th dungeon in our island ruins series and its by far the biggest yet. Explore the ancient corridors and trapped chambers, hunt new enemies and gain riches with a new questline to gains bounties through each of the new adventures.

Your new quest begins in the trade city of porto following the royal shears quest to open up the brewery and auctionhouse. Once available, the guard captain will begin your quest to gather the heads of the various dungeon bosses, rewarding the player with gold.

Also as many of the new bosses can be very tough, we have reduced the cooldown of eating by 50% to speed up healing.

Hope you guys enjoy all the new adventures and the riches that await you.

Good Hunting All

notes.title: Major Expansion
notes.content:
This last month has been a huge step forward in our game,  adding many new features and improvement from our wonderful community. 

Todays update will be the largest yet. We have expanded our world pushing the boundaries of our oceans farther adding 2 new ocean blocks and 16 new islands for exploration. Also game controller support was added and a more efficient and better looking landscape, an improved dungeon loot system, a new sparring arena for skill training and some new defensive moves by player request.

I hope you enjoy our latest update, and I look forward to whats coming next.

notes.title: New update is live
notes.content:
After a rocky launch we are excited to release our latest update to new world horizon.  As we begin to swap out much of the placeholder art, the feel is really starting to come to life. As well as bug fixes, this update goes a long ways on the performance side as we continue to find ways in the engine to make it run smoother.

We will begin preparing for the world expansion hopefully coming this week and I would also like to get game controller support as gameplay currently is a bit difficult with a standard mouse.

I hope you enjoy our update and look forward to any input you guys might have on improving things so please keep those ideas coming and we’ll try our best to make it happen.

Thanks again
Jeff
admin@newworldhorizon.net
